english.title: Impersonate vehicle examiner
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive, falsely represented yourself to be a person entitled under regulations made by virtue of Section 22A(2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 to carry out examinations of vehicles in accordance with the said regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 43B(1) and (2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
